drivers.name: 10-year real yield
drivers.note: Rising real yields raise the cost of holding gold, which pays no interest.

drivers.name: Broad U.S. dollar index
drivers.note: Gold is priced in dollars; a stronger dollar usually weighs on it.

drivers.name: 10-year breakeven inflation
drivers.note: Higher expected inflation lifts demand for gold as an inflation hedge.

drivers.name: 10-year term premium
drivers.note: A rising term premium signals worry about U.S. debt supply, the fiscal-risk case for gold.

drivers.name: 10-year Treasury yield
drivers.note: Nominal yield = real yield + breakeven inflation; read it through those two.

drivers.name: 2-year Treasury yield
drivers.note: Tracks where the market expects the Fed's policy rate to go.

drivers.name: 10-year minus 2-year (curve)
drivers.note: Steepening led by the long end often reflects fiscal or inflation worry.
